page.overview:
What is No Remorse?

No Remorse is the eighth track from Metallica's debut album, Kill 'Em All. It was written by James Hetfield and Lars Ulrich. The song is at a moderate tempo for much of the song but changes tempo towards the end.

The song is about how soldiers in a war are not meant to show any remorse while killing.

An early version of the song appears on Ron McGovney's 1982 demo, and was often played live when Dave Mustaine was still in the band - in this version, however, the ending part has no vocals, and the lyrics for the chorus are slightly different.

In 1993 a sample of the song's chorus was used in the famous game Doom, on the first level.
